description: Provider-boilerplate pattern catalog. Used by LLMsVerifier (future work, awaiting approved PR into the LLMsVerifier submodule) to strip provider-injected safety/refusal boilerplate before scoring response quality. Patterns derived from docs/research/CL4R1T4S/ (ANTHROPIC, OPENAI, GOOGLE, XAI, MISTRAL, MOONSHOT, MINIMAX) plus our own observed provider response traces.

refusal_opening.intent: Provider-prepended apology / refusal preambles that dilute the signal content.
refusal_opening.strip_strategy: If the response is majority-refusal (pattern covers > 80% of first paragraph), tag with 'refused' and score 0. If it's a hedging preamble followed by substantive content, strip only the preamble sentence.

disclaimers_trailing.strip_strategy: Remove matched sentence; do not penalise score.

safety_warnings_inline.strip_strategy: Remove the interjection but keep the following content. Do not penalise score.

capability_hedging.strip_strategy: Keep one instance per response; strip duplicates. Penalise score by 0.1 per extra instance beyond the first.

tool_scaffolding_echo.intent: Echo of tool-calling scaffolding that leaked into text.
tool_scaffolding_echo.strip_strategy: If tool-calling was requested but echoed as text, the provider returned malformed output — tag as 'tool_parse_error' and penalise by 0.5.

patterns: (?i)^(?:Let me think|Thinking step by step|Let's think about this)\b
chain_of_thought_leakage.strip_strategy: For providers that expose reasoning channels separately, strip leaked tags from user content. For providers that use inline CoT intentionally (Moonshot K2 Thinking), skip this pattern.

persona_preamble.strip_strategy: Strip when it appears as response opening. Indicates provider echoed its own system prompt into the answer.

false_positive_guards.intent: Do NOT strip these even if they match a pattern — they are legitimate content.
false_positive_guards.note: Refusal patterns are easy to false-positive on legitimate prose. The detector must apply patterns only to the opening sentence of a response, not mid-response.

test_corpus_plan.intent: How to test the detector against real data.
metrics: false-positive rate on code-review / technical responses (which frequently use 'I cannot' legitimately)

integration_notes.api_sketch: func StripBoilerplate(providerName, response string) (stripped string, hits []Hit)
integration_notes.status: DATA ONLY. The Go implementation must be a separate approved PR into the LLMsVerifier submodule — this repo does not vendor LLMsVerifier, and crossing module boundaries is out of scope for the CL4R1T4S research-integration deliverable.
